hook-a: Flat vector-style illustration, minimalist character design, soft painterly digital art, muted desaturated color palette, gentle color gradients, clean simple linework. Human figures shown as simple silhouettes with featureless or barely suggested faces — no detailed facial features. Human figures shown as simple silhouettes with exaggerated, dramatic body language — bigger gestures, tenser posture, more dynamic poses than a neutral illustration. Three separate silhouettes standing in a row — a romantic partner, a friend and a family member — each surrounded by a subtle warning glow, unified cold background.
